item.title: Will meet Trump in Florida on 28 Dec for Ukraine security guarantees: Zelenskyy
item.description: Weekend meeting comes amid stalled peace efforts, continued fighting and competing demands from Kyiv and Moscow

item.title: ISL: Light at end of tunnel with 5 February likely starting date
item.description: AIFF to ‘own and operate’ the league, lay down 20-year blueprint from next year

item.title: Kyiv hit by fresh missile and drone attack ahead of Zelenskyy–Trump talks
item.description: Kyiv was shaken by a series of powerful explosions early on Saturday after Ukrainian authorities warned that the capital was under threat of a missile attack, amid a broader wave of Russian strikes across the country.

item.title: When, and how, did we move from 'merry' and 'happy' to 'safe Christmas'
item.description: “For the first time in my life, I received messages wishing me a safe Christmas — not happy, not merry. For seven decades, Christmas was assumed to be benign and joyous. This year, that assumption collapsed.”

item.title: Southern Yemen separatists accuse Saudi Arabia of airstrikes amid rising tensions
item.description: Southern Yemen separatists accuse Saudi Arabia of airstrikes on their forces, exposing deep rifts within the anti-Houthi coalition and risking fresh instability in the war-ravaged country.

item.title: Mosque bombing in Homs kills eight, deepening Syria’s sectarian tensions
item.description: At least eight people were killed and 18 wounded after a bomb ripped through a mosque in Syria’s Homs during Friday prayers, highlighting enduring sectarian and security tensions despite an easing of major fighting.

item.title: Trump says Ukraine peace plan hinges on his approval ahead of Zelenskyy talks
item.description: US President Donald Trump has said that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky “doesn’t have anything until I approve it”, underlining Washington’s central role in shaping a proposed peace deal to end the war between Ukraine and Russia.

item.title: Centre clears 260 MW Dulhasti Stage-II hydropower project in Jammu and Kashmir
item.description: A panel under the Ministry of Environment has approved the 260-megawatt Dulhasti Stage-II hydropower project on the Chenab river in Jammu and Kashmir’s Kishtwar district, officials said on Saturday.

item.title: US airstrikes on IS militants mark escalation in Nigeria’s northwest conflict
item.description: United States airstrikes targeting Islamic State-linked militants in northwestern Nigeria have marked a significant escalation in efforts to counter armed groups that Nigeria’s overstretched military has struggled to contain for years.

item.title: West Bengal officers flag concerns over large-scale voter deletions in draft rolls
item.description: A West Bengal government officers’ association has flagged “system-driven” deletion of voters’ names from the draft electoral rolls during the ongoing Special Intensive Revision, raising concerns over due process.
